title: Pies & Pages
seo_title: Pies & Pages at Book Burrow in Lebanon, MO
description: Pies & Pages is a pre-holiday evening at The Book Burrow with pie tasting, a book-themed Family Feud, laughs from the Unthankful Jar, and a storewide sale. It's an evening for book lovers, and tickets are required. It takes place Friday, November 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Book Burrow, 114 W Commercial St., Lebanon, MO.
